opportunities.exact_proposed_theorem: There exists a dimension-independent finite C (ideally C=2) such that for every finite d, every finite traceless Hermitian frame Ai, and every CPTP, unital, HS-self-adjoint, self-compatible Phi, V-k <= C(V-sPhi), where tau=Tr/d, V=sum tau(Ai^2), sPhi=sum tau(Ai Phi(Ai)), and k is the maximum squared-mean score over one common pure ensemble with barycenter I/d.

Current single-observable roofs and copy-ladder results do not establish this gate.

opportunities.concrete_new_mechanism: Orthogonal real and imaginary parts reduce pure spin expectations to a plane normal. The compression determinant gives a concave simplex function, so three coordinate-plane constraints imply global dual majorization. Convex KKT points and explicit plane-pair ensembles match in every regime.
